## Services Offered

### Roofing
Professional roofing installation, repair, and replacement for residential and commercial properties. Services include:
- Roof tear-off and full replacement
- Storm and hail damage repair
- Insurance claim documentation
- Architectural asphalt shingles
- Impact-resistant shingles
- Metal roofing installation

### Siding
High-quality siding installation and repair services:
- Vinyl siding installation
- Fiber cement siding
- Wood siding
- Weather-tight installation
- Curb appeal enhancement

### Gutters
Expert gutter installation, cleaning, and maintenance:
- Seamless aluminum gutter systems
- Foundation protection
- Gutter repair and full replacement
- Professional installation

### Soffit
Professional soffit installation and repair:
- Improved attic ventilation
- Pest and moisture blocking
- Matched to roofline specifications

### Fascia
Durable fascia installation and replacement:
- Roof edge protection
- Rotted board replacement
- Clean, matched finish

### Windows & Doors
Custom window and door installation:
- Energy-efficient replacement windows
- Patio doors and entry doors
- Professional weather sealing

### Full Scale Interior Work
Comprehensive interior renovation services:
- Drywall installation, finishing, and repair
- Trim and painting
- Room additions
- Full interior remodels
- Clean job site maintenance daily

### Exterior Work
Complete exterior construction and renovation:
- Siding, roofing, and gutter integration
- Full exterior renovations
- Single accountable crew

### Drywall
Professional drywall services:
- Drywall installation
- Finishing and repair
- Smooth, flawless interior walls

### General Contracting
Full-service general contracting:
- Residential construction projects
- Commercial construction projects
- Project management from planning to completion

## Project Pricing & Estimates
Every project is priced from a free on-site estimate. Cost depends on:
- Square footage
- Materials selected
- Condition of existing structure
- Scope of work

A&S Contracting Services provides detailed written estimates with no hidden fees or upselling. The quoted price is the final price.

Free estimates are scheduled within days of initial contact. Clear start windows are provided in writing.

## Insurance Claims
A&S Contracting Services handles storm and hail damage insurance claims:
- Documents all storm and hail damage with photos
- Provides detailed itemized estimates
- Meets with insurance adjusters on-site
- Helps homeowners navigate the claims process
- Ensures smooth progression from inspection to installation

## Typical Project Timelines
- Most single-family roof replacements: 1-3 days (weather permitting)
- Siding projects: varies by square footage and home size
- Interior renovations: depends on scope of work
- All timelines provided in writing during estimate phase

The same crew handles every stage of the project, ensuring predictable timelines from first day to final walkthrough.

## Service Philosophy
A&S Contracting Services was founded with a focus on roofing and exterior work and has expanded to offer a full range of residential construction services under one licensed roof. The company self-performs every trade—roofing, siding, gutters, drywall, windows, and interior work—eliminating the trade gaps and subcontracted surprises common in the construction industry.

Every project is handled by the same accountable team from the initial estimate through final walkthrough, providing consistent quality across Warren County and central Missouri.
